title: Exact symmetric monoidal component inverse image
statement: For an affine scheme T [def-pc-scheme], the fixed component test functor and Lan/sheafification inverse image [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model] are continuous and exact on abelian sheaves. The actual inverse image has a strong braided structure for the usual sheaf tensors; no w-contractibility hypothesis is required.

source.place: Construction (4.1), the induced morphism of sites and its inverse image

proof.text: The relative test theorem presents direct image as precomposition and gives preservation of finite limits. Sheaf preservation along the displayed natural isomorphism proves continuity.

The profinite slice has finite limits. Thus the test functor is representably flat. Its opposite Kan extension and sheafification preserve finite limits. The explicit constructed adjunction gives preservation of colimits.

Filtered Kan extension and tensor cocontinuity make the canonical oplax tensor comparisons invertible. The right adjoint is lax braided, so transposition through the monoidal adjunction proves braidedness of its strong monoidal left adjoint.
